primarySources.contract: UrlAccess accepts the exact keys url-access, acesso-url and acessourl. Its finite accepted enum list is subscrição, limitada, limitado, registo, registro, registration and limited.

Validation lowercases enum input, but the later renderer maps only registo/registro to registration, subscrição to subscription and limitada to limited. Every other accepted value is then cleared. Accepted validation values and rendered access icons are separate contracts.
The whitelist accepts native UrlAccess keys independently of whether a supplied enum produces a visible access icon.

policy: Preserve already accepted native argument keys and values, including accepted values ignored by the renderer. Only the independently proved invalid subscription value has a separate source-bound repair to subscrição. No broader enum equivalence is asserted.
